From ecb40d0826fda213ebb58d49e7d5b4752480e130 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Matt Roper <matthew.d.roper@intel.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2020 13:47:34 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] drm/i915: Update bw_buddy pagemask table

A recent bspec update removed the LPDDR4 single channel entry from the
buddy register table, but added a new four-channel entry.

Workaround 1409767108 hasn't been updated with any guidance for four
channel configurations, so we leave that alternate table unchanged for
now.

Bspec 49218
Fixes: 3fa01d642fa7 ("drm/i915/tgl: Program BW_BUDDY registers during display init")
Signed-off-by: Matt Roper <matthew.d.roper@intel.com>
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20200612204734.3674650-1-matthew.d.roper@intel.com
Reviewed-by: Lucas De Marchi <lucas.demarchi@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Rodrigo Vivi <rodrigo.vivi@intel.com>

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/display/intel_display_power.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/display/intel_display_power.c
index 788bd4516365..9f0241a53a45 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/display/intel_display_power.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/i915/display/intel_display_power.c
@@ -5240,10 +5240,10 @@ struct buddy_page_mask {
 };
 
 static const struct buddy_page_mask tgl_buddy_page_masks[] = {
-	{ .num_channels = 1, .type = INTEL_DRAM_LPDDR4, .page_mask = 0xE },
 	{ .num_channels = 1, .type = INTEL_DRAM_DDR4,   .page_mask = 0xF },
 	{ .num_channels = 2, .type = INTEL_DRAM_LPDDR4, .page_mask = 0x1C },
 	{ .num_channels = 2, .type = INTEL_DRAM_DDR4,   .page_mask = 0x1F },
+	{ .num_channels = 4, .type = INTEL_DRAM_LPDDR4, .page_mask = 0x38 },
 	{}
 };
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/gpu/drm/i915/display/intel_display_power.c`**
   - Removed the entry for single-channel LPDDR4 from the `tgl_buddy_page_masks` array.
   - Added a new entry for four-channel LPDDR4 with a page mask of `0x38`.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The patch updates the `tgl_buddy_page_masks` structure to reflect changes in the hardware specifications (bspec) regarding memory configurations. Specifically, it removes the outdated single-channel LPDDR4 entry and introduces a new four-channel LPDDR4 entry. This change is necessary to ensure that the driver correctly handles the updated memory configuration for display initialization, as indicated by the recent bspec update. The workaround for four-channel configurations remains unchanged due to the lack of guidance, indicating a cautious approach to the new hardware support.

Here is the commit message:
drm/i915: Update bw_buddy pagemask table

A recent bspec update removed the LPDDR4 single channel entry from the
buddy register table, but added a new four-channel entry.

Workaround 1409767108 hasn't been updated with any guidance for four
channel configurations, so we leave that alternate table unchanged for
now.

Bspec 49218
Fixes: 3fa01d642fa7 ("drm/i915/tgl: Program BW_BUDDY registers during display init")
Signed-off-by: Matt Roper <matthew.d.roper@intel.com>
Link: https://patchwork.freedesktop.org/patch/msgid/20200612204734.3674650-1-matthew.d.roper@intel.com
Reviewed-by: Lucas De Marchi <lucas.demarchi@intel.com>
Signed-off-by: Rodrigo Vivi <rodrigo.vivi@intel.com>

Here is the root cause:
The bug was caused by the removal of the single-channel LPDDR4 entry from the buddy register table in the hardware specifications (bspec) without updating the driver to reflect this change. The driver still contained the outdated entry, which could lead to incorrect memory configuration handling during display initialization. The addition of a new four-channel entry was necessary to align the driver with the updated specifications, but the absence of guidance for four-channel configurations meant that the workaround remained unchanged.

Here is the patch:
 
 static const struct buddy_page_mask tgl_buddy_page_masks[] = {
-	{ .num_channels = 1, .type = INTEL_DRAM_LPDDR4, .page_mask = 0xE },
 	{ .num_channels = 1, .type = INTEL_DRAM_DDR4,   .page_mask = 0xF },
 	{ .num_channels = 2, .type = INTEL_DRAM_LPDDR4, .page_mask = 0x1C },
 	{ .num_channels = 2, .type = INTEL_DRAM_DDR4,   .page_mask = 0x1F },
+	{ .num_channels = 4, .type = INTEL_DRAM_LPDDR4, .page_mask = 0x38 },
 	{}
 };
